description: Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A or EAN-8 as SVG/PNG/data URL. EAN/UPC: pass digits without check digit to have it added, or with it to verify. Static codes only: no redirects, no dynamic/editable codes, no scan analytics. EAN/UPC output is format-valid (check digit) and is NOT GS1 registration. Scannability is not guaranteed (contrast, print size, quiet zone and reader all matter).
